name: resistance-band-machine-hack-squat
instructions:
1. Load the machine with the desired weight then anchor bands to the machine and loop them around the weight pegs.
2. Position your shoulders and back against the pads.
3. Position your feet at shoulder width, extend your legs, and release the safety handles.
4. Slowly lower the weight by bending your knees until your thighs are approximately at 90 degrees.
5. Reverse the movement by driving into the platform and extending the knees and hips.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
